events.title: Marriage to Marie Mercereau
events.description: Sunday 16 Jul 1693, by minister Pierre Peiret after banns on three Sundays; he 'd'Osse en Béarn', she of Moëze in Saintonge. Witnesses signing: Pierre Masse, J. Mercereau, Josué Mercereau, Marie Mercereau, Elie Boudinot. [R4-S1]

events.title: Godfather at Pierre Masse's baptism
events.description: Sponsor, with Marie Susanne Doucinet, for Pierre, son of Pierre Masse and Elisabet Mercereau (John Meier's ancestors' family). [R4-S1]

bio:
The French Church of New York records the marriage on Sunday 16 Jul 1693 of Jean la Tourette, 'of Osse in Béarn', and Marie Mercereau, 'of Moise [Moëze] in Saintonge', by the minister Pierre Peiret, after banns on three successive Sundays. Pierre Masse, J. Mercereau, Josué Mercereau, Marie Mercereau and Elie Boudinot signed as witnesses ([R4-S1]). On the same day Josué Mercereau married Marie Chadaine, with Jean La Tourette among the witnesses. Three weeks earlier, on 25 Jun 1693, Jean had stood godfather to Pierre, son of Pierre Masse and Elisabet Mercereau ([R4-S1]).

The register gives four children: Marie (b. 23 Sep 1693, bapt. 6 Dec 1693), Jean (b. 6 Oct 1695, bapt. 20 Oct 1695, godmother Elizabet Mercereau), Pierre (b. 22 Nov 1697, bapt. 28 Nov 1697; the clerk wrote the father as 'Pierre Latourette', but Jean La Tourette signed) and David (b. 28 Dec 1699, bapt. 7 Jan 1700, sponsors Marie du Bois and Jean Chevalier) ([R4-S1]).
sources: [R4-S1] Collections of the Huguenot Society of America, vol. I (1886): registers of the French Church (Eglise Françoise à la Nouvelle York), transcribed (primary) https://archive.org/details/collectionsofhug01hugu
